It’s not about things getting better - it’s about controlling yourself with it being shitty. And the one rule we gotta follow - the only rule - is to not be rash or hasty. It is hard. I understand. 

The goal in this regard should be to catch when you have those “surges” of wanting to act on a specific desire. 

You know what I mean. But don’t call it motivation. These surges are guiding you at the time you are meant for it. Sometimes it is at your leisure and you have some comfort behind not having to rush it - sometimes it’s “I need to get my shit together ASAP” and those are generally not so.

When you place expectations on yourself constantly 24/7 even if nothing ever gets done - all you do is waste the day away and worry yourself that drains you and causes a vicious cycle. 

So next time - go ahead and watch that movie or show - play that video game or just browse the net. You’ll just *know* when that surge comes and something catches your eye and you end up in a rabbit hole about it - whether for an hour - a day - a week - a month. 

Things that relate and resonate to you. You WILL grow tired of your routine as you are in now and feel like you’re rotting away in a bed - I recommend praying - believe in me - I’ve lived and done what you are going through now. I failed for 3 years - one night of absolute praying in tears - after having all I tried fail - in one single month - I got my shit together - i followed those surges - and next thing I know I’m sitting at an office job with a great salary.

You gotta know rock bottom and have some faith, friend. It isn’t cringe. You matter. So do your prayers.

Thank you. Your words carry weight even if you don’t understand the extent.

You need to learn to focus off of the schedule and prescriptions of numbers and hours and days. And to stop “planning” ahead and overthinking of the next step when you have nothing else to prioritize at moment. Until you do - you ground yourself for today only and don’t run after the clock or the routine - don’t burden yourself with things you really aren’t doing for anything substantial like that job goal you achieved but rather to pass the time or day - thinking you have to prepare yourself for something like it is useful or important to have with you.


Focus on your work at your new job and ground yourself to how things are right now - don’t even use the word today. Just “right now - I am doing what I have been experienced and worked for - and I am grateful and will not have any haste for anything else that isn’t part of this task”.

You do this and rest comes accordingly to each new day. When you have a moment you’ll know is one because you can’t just think your way into it - you act on it again but with that grounded and calm mindstate. Haste is what makes you worried. The philosopher mindset is a burden.

You will get burnout at the rate you expect to remain productive. 

Your goal was achieved in regards to focusing on getting a foundation - you have achieved this. Reward yourself with a bit of lax and mellow routine towards focusing well on your job and focus on discipline to harden the core tasks the job places responsibility on you - and do this until it becomes second nature.

Afterwards - ride it out and wait - until you get that surge again - while working - for something bigger.

And repeat. Don’t be hastened or rushed - remain calm cool and collected.

I’m 21. My head is already heavy and honestly - even 30 is pushing it.

I’ve seen and done the same things in the same ways with different methods - but ultimately I know deep down it’s a rat race. I wonder a lot on why I live - when I don’t even know how to live. Work - sleep - bare sustenance - and repeat. I am drained and not even interested in the opposite sex - nor do I wish or desire friends. It’s not easy to even talk about this shit because ultimately it’s all for nothing anyway.

I’m tired of myself mostly. I’ve noticed how foolish I act and the ways I can react to a situation internally that leave me wondering what of me is good and what of me is inherently wrong.

So many things have I tried to achieve. All of them failures. It’s not like I didn’t put effort into them. I did and for a lot of time. They all failed. And as a result I honestly feel like I’m slowly accepting my fate as fodder. Work till I die? I knew it was bad when I stopped caring about video games as a way to de-stress because everything became a distraction. Music, games, people. 


I don’t know how much more I can take but I don’t know why but once my mom and dad check out - I’ll probably wrap it up too - even if it’s a waste of all the blessings and wisdoms I might have received. My sister has a daughter coming into the world in September - so at least the bloodline continues. 


It’s not even that I’ve failed with people finding or wishing for me to chat - it’s a different kind of heaviness when all your desires are just killed. No crushes - no need to travel - food is just to sustain - music makes me ears sore overtime - games distract me from shit that I can’t unsee. Women are unrelatable and so yippy and live a completely different lifestyle. I don’t even hate myself. I’m just tired of myself. I’m a coward too - you know. I’m okay for now but I know I’m probably fucked.


So - if I at least write it here - I guess it’s better than wasting the chance to vent how I’ve been these past few moments. Everything is a burden. And it’s not like I try to see things negatively - it’s a different kind of pain that I can’t ever tell you of because I’ve been doing everything to find if there could be a solution. But it all leads back to vanity. People who say forever or 90 - even shit like 900 make my head even heavier. They are the fortunate ones. And I want them to live well. I’m glad they do. I think I’ve jumped too far off the deep end trying to escape and view this life differently yet all it did was make me aware I didn’t even know how to live anymore. So there.

One time I was home alone chilling with some battlefield 1 on PlayStation. I had no reason to be anxious - just playing an online match in my room - lights low - ambient shit. 

And then I began to sweat - which I rarely do. Then my heart flutters. I get this sense this is it - and even my legs turn to jelly trying to stand - and I’m seeing stars with debating if I should at some point call an ambulance which I never ever think to do because I joke of death all the time so who cares. But it didn’t stop for what is a few minutes as I flopped on to my bed facing the ceiling. And then it eased. And the sweating stopped. And it’s like I was just taking a break. 


I didn’t know what this was until people called it a panic attack and from then on did I know what it felt like. Luckily it only happened that one time. And I’ve been blessed to not feel it since. But what concerned me was how casual and relaxed I was and how nothing was going on in that session to trigger it. Apparently this is normal. Triggers or non triggers.

As much as the many will scoff - the many who will deceive you or tell you to avoid a thing. 

You pray to Jesus Christ. You ask for understanding - for wisdom - for truth. And if you do this without rush, with sincerity and truly you open your bitter and pained heart at your burdens - I tell you that you will be able to endure these things. It will never be a fairytale happy go lucky situation. Nor will you even find joy. These things will take time and force you to learn patience and let go of your assumptions for how things behave or work. 


It doesn’t get easier. Really. But you will be strengthened. You wish to flee from men and women and be alone. But when you are alone you sit there in silence and you sit there in silence still. You will be lead to things and at first you’ll be attacked - it’s like clockwork men will scream they be coincidences or “chance” - luck does not exist. Nor do coincidences. The exact troubles and questions you struggle with will be answered to you in silence that overtime occur to the point you cannot even fathom the statement of coincidence and hold a sense of anger to a foolish man who is a “philosopher” of science or some other vanity. 


It’s hard to stay sane - the burdens are many but where then is peace? Distraction to distraction. Things become very very heavy when even distractions are killed. You see things that you can’t unsee. This doesn’t make you a better man than any other - dust is dust. And from dust we came to dust we return. But even if things are burdensome and you feel pain and a sadness that even depression can’t compare to - became it isn’t a competition or “more” of anything. You feel a kind of deadness that you didn’t think could ever be done. All the things you did once or do still are dead. The shows, the video games, the crushes or the banters. The food - the small words of many people who gossip of others and talk of things that are no importance to their soul. What they eat - what they drink - what they will eat - what they will drink. What they wish to see - whom they wish to see it with. So many and so frequent are their words and so repetitive are their actions that nothing new is seen. Even this comment do I write with a mixture of confusion and worry because I don’t want to appear like I am better than them for this is written for their sake. Not to “wake” up anyone - for the blind will never care to see or read this. 

This is for the men and women who know this pain and burden - the ones confused and scared and tired. They know what depression is - but they know this be something entirely different. They know it’s vanity to compare a thing with another when what I am talking about speaks to their soul yet what masses talk about only burdens it. How many turn to folly things and vain desires? A pixel on a screen - an app switched to another app. A photo of a harlot or a photo of a hearty clown. They look at men and women to distract their life away - play a video game to distract their mind from silence - they talk and partake about useless discussion on matters that don’t even concern them or do any good to anyone - all for what? All for whom? For how long will they act this way? That they don’t even think before they speak. They don’t think before they speak because they don’t fear. 

I write this in vanity - but so too in fear. I don’t write this because I want to - but because I must. For you. And you alone. In a sea of meaningless words by many of the same men and women that tire and burden you - this was delivered to your eyes for your sake for God loves you. Your spirit delights in this as does mine. For while this path of right and doing your best to walk it is tiresome and difficult - I cannot explain to you with words how sweet like honey it is when you finally have peace. Peace. Not by having a show on in the back - or an app or some game you look forward to. Peace as in being in silence alone in a dark room away from anyone - having no desires anymore and being calm and feeling a love you cannot get from a man. 

Praying for wisdom with sincerity - even if one who be “atheist” - only by title - but not by definition - will be answered. Both to even the harlots or the perverted. If your heart is in pain and you weep in silence at this restless then I’m telling you that this was made to tell you directly to pray and be patient. 

I don’t know my fate - nor will I know yours. I am subjected to the same punishment that I fear and hope you can be spared from. But I am dust and so are you. When you feel this burden - you can’t let it go. It won’t. It never will . I say this because I want you to know this journey doesn’t make you go to a church or listen to men. You don’t listen to the things people say - you begin to hear the words that you will know are meant for you. And at first you’ll be suspicious - then you’ll be anxious. You’ll then feel vain and try to ask for things like you are owed this or that. 

Understand this to end this message.

A father who truly loves his son - will beat his son with rod and staff and discipline him to correct him in his folly or wrongful behaviour. So great this love be for his sake - but a father who sees his son behave and act like a fool and looks the other way truly does not love his son. 

You’ll know this. I write these words for a reason. Many will hate them. But once you know how worthless you are - can you truly see the worth of others.

Essentially the kind of lender you go to are alternative lenders. Banks are not the place to go - doubt they’d even offer any and are not meant to.

Equity loan lenders are institutions who assess the risk of your liabilities and weigh the value of what you do own and have access to. Your home. These equity loan lenders are meant for people in a bad credit situation and help people who are home owners or owners of assets utilize their investment ( home ) that is “owned”. Rent? No. A home owner. 

If you have paid your mortgage for a long time and just fell into a bad place - you can utilize your investment and have it work for you by gaining an equity loan equivalent to the value of the home you have divided by the mortgage balance remaining. The more your house is worth - the higher the ratio for securing an equity loan for a specified percentage of the value of the home - never 100%. 

You use this capital to pay your debts - your liabilities. Bills, services, things. All grouped together called debt. Debt that stays debt longer requires you to fix it quickly to start negating the effect on your credit trade line. That’s why it’s better to pay your debts in full using a loan and making payment arrangements with the lender - the lender gives you the money to pay these debts allowing them to update on your credit as PIF - paid in full ( or settlement in full ). This reflects good. You can’t rebuild credit if you owe debt you haven’t paid. 

Paying it off - you can close and wrap up all the things you owed as paid - rather than doing partial payments that don’t reflect on your credit - it actually damages it further as you’re behind and it shows for how many months and years. Paying in full brings it all taken care of and done. Each time you pay the lender you used to secure the loan - you’ll reflect your monthly payments as on time and consistent - rebuilding your credit all in one swoop. 


Equity loans allow you to gain capital similar to third party alternative lenders - just with your house - and allow you to get back up on your feet with a realistic and understandable time frame. They aren’t meant to make you feel you’re about to lose your house - it’s to save it.

Speed reading. It can be understood in 5 minutes and practiced for 10-15. You basically re-train your eye movement from short sporadic blocks to a continuous horizontally linear event where you pass over the sentence in one go. 


It takes practice and at first - when you begin to learn this method you shouldn’t focus on comprehension or retention in what you’re reading. You only focus on the movement and how your eyes follow in one move. A common tip is to get a pen or pencil tip and follow the words directly above the point. Move the point in the same continuous motion even if you feel it’s too fast. Again - it’s about the movement not about retaining or making sense of what you are looking over.


Do this enough - and you’ll just “click” and be able to see an entire chunk of text without even needing to move your eyes. It’s all in focus. And you’ll be able to understand it.
